strategy_rationale: No time or group structure detected (split_structure confirms i.i.d. tabular data). Binary classification with minority class rate ~38% — moderate imbalance warrants stratified sampling to ensure each fold preserves the target class ratio, making OOF scores leaderboard-aligned. Stratified k-fold (5 folds) is the first-match priority for class_imbalance on i.i.d. data and best simulates the hidden evaluation where test passengers are drawn from the same distribution without temporal ordering.
simulates_hidden_evaluation: Each fold holds out ~20% of passengers stratified by survival rate; the hidden test set is similarly drawn from the same passenger pool without temporal or group ordering. OOF accuracy tracks leaderboard accuracy closely.

leakage_risks.action: Extract title/social feature only; do not use raw Name string as a model feature
Extract ticket prefix / group-size aggregate per fold; do not use raw ticket as feature
Extract deck letter only; 77% missing — treat missingness as informative feature
Monitor; train/test come from the same manifest so shift is sampling noise

validation_limitations: Stratified k-fold assumes train and test passengers are i.i.d. If test passengers were selected with any hidden temporal or cabin-class bias, OOF accuracy will overestimate leaderboard accuracy. Distribution shift detected in columns [] (train vs test mean z-score > 0.3).
